airConditioning.description:
The air conditioning can be turned on or off using the provided remote controls.
The temperature adjusts automatically according to the room's conditions.

It is recommended to turn it off when no coworker is in the room.
airConditioning.label: Air conditioning

carbonDioxide.description:
The CO2 level is an indicator of air quality. A high level can cause headaches, fatigue and a decrease in concentration.

It is recommended to ventilate the workspace when the CO2 level exceeds 1000 ppm.
carbonDioxide.label: CO2 level

excessive: No choice: windows need to be opened
high: The concentration is getting too high
medium: Levels are within the normal range
unknown: The level could not be retrieved

climate.description: The room's atmosphere is monitored in real time to ensure your comfort.
climate.label: Atmosphere

coffeeMachine.description:
The coffee machine, which can also be used for tea, is self-service.
A personal mug is recommended and can be <0>ordered from the shop</0>; shared spots are available at the entrance of Le Poulailler to leave it there.

<1>A contribution</1> is appreciated in case of regular use.
coffeeMachine.label: Coffee machine

deckDoor.description: This door directly leads to the deck, and can be opened from the exterior to enter the workspace.
deckDoor.label: Unlock the deck door
deckDoor.missingCapability:
Unlocking the door requires a little bit of seniority.
You will be able to do so once you have accumulated 10 days of activity.

empty.description: What do you want to manage if there is nothing to do?
empty.title: Chaos

flexDesk.description:
This sit-stand desk allows you to work sitting or standing, depending on your preferences.
It is available without reservation, with a real-time status to check if it is free or occupied.
flexDesk.label: Sit-stand desk

fridge.description:
The refrigerator is available for all members.
It is emptied regularly and without notice to maintain cleanliness.
It's recommended not to leave food for extended periods.
fridge.label: Fridge

groupWork.description:
An adjacent room is dedicated to collective exchanges: meetings, video calls, or group discussions.
It helps preserve the calm of the open space, where discretion is expected.
This area is shared and should be used occasionally so everyone can benefit from it.
groupWork.label: Collaborative space

intercom.description:
The doorbell most often signals the arrival of a member or a visitor.
Members are encouraged to answer the intercom to grant access. This simple gesture contributes to the welcoming and convivial atmosphere of the coworking space.
intercom.label: Intercom

deck.description:
This box allows you to retrieve the keys to unlock the deck door when you are unable to enter the building.

It is located to the right of the door and requires a code to open it.
deck.label: Access deck keys

keyBoxes.missingCapability:
Opening the key box requires a bit of seniority.
You will be able to do it once you have acquired 10 days of activity.

poulailler.description:
This key box allows you to retrieve the shared office keys in order to:
	• open it when you are the first to arrive,
	• close it when you are the last to leave.

It is located on the left of the entrance door and a code is required to open it.
poulailler.label: Access Poulailler keys

ptiPoulailler.description:
This key box allows you to retrieve the shared office keys in order to:
	• open it when you are the first to arrive,
	• close it when you are the last to leave.

It is located on the right of the entrance door and a code is required to open it.
ptiPoulailler.label: Access P'ti Poulailler keys

onFetch.fail: Unable to retrieve P'ti Poulailler code

storage.description: The storage room contains all the equipment necessary for the maintenance and upkeep of the spaces.
storage.descriptionFr: Le stock contient tout le matériel nécessaire à l'entretien et à la maintenance des espaces.
storage.label: Access storage room keys
storage.missingCapability: Opening the storage room key box requires specific access that you do not have. Too bad.

onFetch.fail: Unable to retrieve storage room code

hub.description:
The Hub is a <0>small meeting room</0> designed for working groups of up to six people. It is located near the P'ti Poulailler, next to the building's entrance.

Access is provided via a key kept in a secure key box mounted to the left of the door. A code is required to open the box.
hub.label: Access the Hub

hubFrench.description:
Le Hub est une <0>petite salle de réunion</0> conçue pour accueillir des groupes de travail jusqu'à six personnes. Elle est située proche du P'ti Poulailler, à coté de la porte d'entrée du bâtiment.

L'accès se fait à l'aide d'une clé rangée dans une boîte à clés sécurisée, accrochée à gauche de la porte. L'ouverture de cette boîte nécessite un code.
hubFrench.label: Accéder au Hub

phoneBooths.description:
Phone booths are isolated spaces intended for short calls.
They are equipped with electrical outlets and ventilation.
They are not reservable and are accessible to all.
phoneBooths.label: Phone Booths

printer.description:
The printer is accessible on the network or from <0>your account</0>.
Usage should remain occasional and reasonable.

A contribution is requested in case of regular printing, available in <1>the shop</1>.
printer.label: Printer

television.description:
The television screen in the space displays important information from Le Poulailler: attendance, upcoming events, internal announcements, and reminders of the rules.

It serves as the digital notice board of the coworking space, designed to keep everyone informed about community life.
television.label: Television

credentials.missingCapability: Wi-Fi credentials are only available to members and visitors.

wifi.description:
The Wi-Fi network provides Internet access and automatically records presence through the device's MAC address.
If you change devices, the address can be updated directly from <0>the app</0> or <1>the website</1>.

Usage should remain professional and reasonable; heavy downloads and BitTorrent are prohibited.
wifi.label: Wi-Fi network
